purpose: Pin the VERIFICATION_PLAN item 1-6 Tamarin models to the real crypto code: every abstract function the models use (h, senc, sign, aenc) is anchored to a concrete implementation value or refusal recorded here.

kdf.info_format: b'advanced-vpn/hybrid-kem/v1|' + context + b'|' + sha256(ephemeral || mlkem_ct || recipient_public)
kdf.key_material: x25519_shared || mlkem768_shared (both shared secrets; the hybrid_compatibility abstraction)

kem_seal.aead: AES-256-GCM, 12-byte nonce, associated data = context (the context_binding anchor)

ohttp.request_info: REQUEST_INFO + header; per-request fresh reply key (X25519)
ohttp.freshness: abs(now - t) <= 60s; replay cache in memory

fdh.function:
Hash `token` to an integer in [1, n) with SHA-256 in counter mode.

    Deterministic and domain-separated for this credit scheme; the digest
    stream is interpreted big-endian and reduced modulo n. The result is
    coprime to n except with negligible probability, which the caller
    tolerates (verification simply fails for a bad draw).
fdh.domain: the token->element map the model abstracts as h(token)

enrollment.signed_object: the canonical manifest bytes (the model's manifest hash)

link_source_pins.note: src/link.rs is Rust; live vectors need the owner's cargo runtime. These are source-pinned format references for the model's k1/k2 abstractions.

cloak_source_pins.note: src/cloak.rs is Rust; live vectors need the owner's cargo runtime.
